title: Accelerated Frank-Wolfe Algorithms: Complementarity Conditions and Sparsity
abstract: arXiv:2511.02821v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We develop new accelerated first-order algorithms in the Frank-Wolfe (FW) family for minimizing smooth convex functions over compact convex sets, with a focus on two prominent constraint classes: (1) polytopes and (2) matrix domains given by the spectrahedron and nuclear-norm balls. A key technical ingredient is a complementarity condition that captures solution sparsity---face dimension for polytopes and rank for matrices. translated_title: 加速Frank-Wolfe算法：互补条件与稀疏性
translated_abstract: 我们为在紧凸集上最小化光滑凸函数的问题开发了Frank-Wolfe（FW）族中新的加速一阶算法，重点关注两类重要的约束集合：（1）多面体和（2）由谱面体（spectrahedron）和核范数球给出的矩阵域。一个关键技术要素是刻画解稀疏性的互补条件——对多面体而言是面的维度，对矩阵而言是秩。我们提出了两种算法：（1）一种针对多面体的纯线性优化oracle（LOO）方法，具有最优的最坏情况一阶（FO）oracle复杂度，除有限的“预热”（burn-in）阶段和至多一个对数因子外，其LOO复杂度随 $r/\sqrt{\epsilon}$ 缩放，其中 $\epsilon$ 是目标精度，$r$ 是解的稀疏度（与环境维度无关）；（2）一种将FW与稀疏投影oracle（例如矩阵域的低秩SVD）相结合的混合方案。
tldr: 本文提出了基于互补条件刻画解稀疏性的新型加速Frank-Wolfe算法，在多面体和矩阵域约束下实现了复杂度仅依赖解稀疏度（而非环境维度）的最优一阶oracle复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper develops new accelerated Frank-Wolfe algorithms leveraging complementarity conditions that characterize solution sparsity, achieving optimal first-order oracle complexity depending on solution sparsity rather than ambient dimension for polytope and matrix domain constraints.
